sql: select 'live' src, strategy, quantity::text q, status, count(*) n, min(created_at) first_at from live_orders where strategy='Jmmsell10' group by 1,2,3,4 union all select 'paper', strategy, '', '', count(*), min(created_at) from paper_trades where strategy in ('Jmmsell10','Jmmsell10_pt4') group by 1,2 union all select 'twin_row', twin_tag, live_tag, coalesce(ended_at::text,'open'), 1, started_at from live_paper_twins where twin_tag='Jmmsell10_pt4' union all select 'parity', live_outcome, twin_outcome, '', count(*), min(recorded_at) from live_paper_parity_events where twin_tag='Jmmsell10_pt4' group by 1,2,3
